scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run worker --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
